config firewall address
edit "ACME_mixed.example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "mixed.example.com"
set associated-interface "wan1"
set color 5
set allow-routing enable
next

edit "ACME_10.10.10.0/24"
set subnet 10.10.10.0 255.255.255.0
set associated-interface "wan1"
set color 5
set allow-routing enable
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "ACME_Generated Objects"
set member "ACME_mixed.example.com" "ACME_10.10.10.0/24"
next

end
